finding: At the pinned rust-sdk commit, ClientCapabilities' builder field list includes sampling: SamplingCapability. The generic builder macro generates enable_sampling(), which sets sampling to Some(SamplingCapability::default()), and enable_sampling_with(...), which sets sampling to Some(the supplied capability). The same file's tests construct ClientCapabilities with .enable_sampling().build() and verify serialized JSON contains an object-valued sampling field. Combined with the prior r251 finding that ClientCapabilities::default() leaves sampling=None and serde skips None, this establishes in the exact pinned builder/serialization scope that sampling advertisement is explicit opt-in rather than default.
